finalMessage:
I added the three Claude 5.5 models to `src/prices.js` and a test that costs one request on each. `npm test` passes: 17 of 17, the 16 existing tests plus the new one.

**Prices added** (USD per million tokens):

| Model | input | output | cacheRead | cacheWrite (5 min) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-haiku-5-5` (prompts up to 100,000 tokens) | 0.1 | 0.5 | 0.01 | 0.125 |
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | 2 | 10 | 0.1 | 2.5 |
| `claude-opus-5-5` | 4 | 20 | 0.2 | 5 |

**Where the numbers come from:** I took them from Anthropic's pricing docs, and they match claude.com/pricing. The recent change you mentioned is probably the Opus 5.5 cut from $5/$25 to $4/$20. Third-party trackers date it to about 2026-10-05, and both official pages already show the new price. Neither official page dates its changes, and I could only fetch them today (2026-10-14). I found nothing suggesting a change between the 13th and today.

**What changed in the files:**
- **`src/prices.js`:** the three entries are added after the existing ones, which are unchanged. There's a new source comment, and the "Last updated" line now reads `2026-10-13, adding the Claude 5.5 models`. I used the 13th because that's the date you asked the prices to reflect, not the day I made the edit. I also added a comment saying the Haiku 5.5 entry is the price for prompts up to 100,000 tokens.
- **`test/cost.test.js`:** the new test, `costOf prices the Claude 5.5 models`, uses the same usage figures as the existing Sonnet 5 test.

**Decision for you:** Haiku 5.5 requests with prompts over 100,000 tokens will be under-billed. The list price is five times higher for those (0.5 / 2.5 / 0.05 / 0.625), and the price table has no way to express that. Supporting it would mean `costOf` picking a price based on the request's total input tokens, including cache reads and writes. That's a separate change I can make if you want it.

Nothing is committed.

Sources:
- [Anthropic pricing docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) (the source cited in the file)
- [claude.com/pricing](https://claude.com/pricing)
- [usagepricing.com: Opus 5.5 price cut, 2026-10-05](https://www.usagepricing.com/blueprint/activity/anthropic-2026-10-05-opus-5-5-price-cut) (third-party, used only for the date)
